text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Friday.
- The introduction of VAT to be postponed for a few months.
- Pensions and salaries to go up in 1997, pledges president Tudjman.
- Several Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ) high- ranking officials suspended from their duties by the HDZ presidency due to breaking the law.
- The former HVO (Croatian Defence Council) member, Zlatko Aleksovski, indicted for war crimes by the Hague tribunal may not be sent to the Hague due to health problems.
- The current November the the warmest in the past 100 years, while September of this year is marked as the coldest in 65 years.
- Italians interested in constructing the future Zagreb-Split motorway. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
